description: Low level: check a raw Word Pass object you already hold (pass, proof, day), offline-style: PazAIr signature, Merkle proof into the day's root, and the root's anchors in Bitcoin and Stellar. Free, no key. Holding only an agent_id or a Word Pass URL? Use check_word_pass, which also gives a verdict.

day.description: A UTC day, ISO 8601 date, e.g. "2026-10-28".

pass.description: The Word Pass object as get_pass returned it.

proof.description: The Merkle proof array as get_pass returned it.

name: verify_pass
